_note: Bench meet test (item 70), by-eye calls (Nov 9). Side-on bench presses from powerlifting meets, one attempt each, the lifter under the referee's commands. Bar height from a CSRT tracker on the near plate (OpenCV, not the judge's tracker), steadied for camera movement by the mean shift of 2-4 CSRT background points, smoothed by a 5-frame median; bottoms checked on 0.1-0.5 s sheets. Same rule as run 1, fixed before the judge ran: pause = time within 5% of the rep's travel of its lowest point; 0.5 s or more white, under 0.3 s red no_pause, in between 'either'. Lockout by eye: back to within 2% of the Start! height (Nazt never got there: spotters took it, red no_lockout). Only the plan's bench checks (pause, lockout) are called; other faults are notes. Meet lights: no clip shows the referees' lights. ak3m attempts 2 and 3 were good by the clip's own title cards (it moves up 175 then 182.5, and the last card reads 'I think I should have added more weight'); the rest are unknown.
